name: humanoid-tree-stocky-continue

jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: build-humanoid-stocky
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; mkdir -p experimental/duck_cuda/build-humanoid-stocky; nvcc -std=c++17 -O3 --fmad=false -gencode arch=compute_89,code=sm_89 -gencode arch=compute_120,code=sm_120 -Ihumanoid/variants/h1_stocky/include -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -Xcompiler -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda.cu -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-humanoid-stocky/libhumanoid_cuda.so 2>&1 | tee build-humanoid-stocky.log; nvcc -std=c++17 -O3 --fmad=true -gencode arch=compute_89,code=sm_89 -gencode arch=compute_120,code=sm_120 -Ihumanoid/variants/h1_stocky/include -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -Xcompiler -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda.cu -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-humanoid-stocky/libhumanoid_cuda_fast.so 2>&1 | tee -a build-humanoid-stocky.log; g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -ffp-contract=off -Ihumanoid/variants/h1_stocky/include -Iexperimental/duck_cuda/include -fPIC -shared experimental/duck_cuda/src/duck_cuda_serial.cpp -o experimental/duck_cuda/build-humanoid-stocky/libhumanoid_cuda_serial.so 2>&1 | tee -a build-humanoid-stocky.log; ls -la experimental/duck_cuda/build-humanoid-stocky | tee -a build-humanoid-stocky.log

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -m walk.train.gpu_train --robot humanoid --variant h1_stocky --envs 16384 --horizon 64 --updates 99999 --seed 917 --device cuda --library experimental/duck_cuda/build-humanoid-stocky/libhumanoid_cuda_fast.so --lane-env --curriculum humanoid-walk --rsi-fraction 0.5 --policy ff --resume runs/warmstart-stocky.pt --accept-every 8 --out gpu-train-out --lr 3e-4 --max-wall-s 600 2>&1 | tee gpu-train.log

accept_probe_note: --accept-every 8: every 8 updates (~60 s at the measured ~7.4 s/update for 16384 envs x 64) the in-run probe judges the current policy on the FROZEN humanoid judge over the CPU harness's exact 12 cells (seeds 4242/7/1913/90210 x 0.50/0.75/1.00 m/s, 8 s) as one E=12 batch on a fresh CUDA-lane instance (DR/gate-termination/RSI off); 12/12 -> writes gpu-train-out/accepted/ (listed as artifacts) and stops the leg, gpu/chain.py stops the chain. Cost: 12 x 4000 ticks with per-tick readback; measured 3.2 s per probe on the local serial lane (12 humanoid envs), estimated <= 5 s on the CUDA lane (4000 one-tick launches + small D2H reads + the same per-tick python), i.e. ~10 probes x <= 5 s <= 50 s of a 600 s leg (< 8.3 %; at the measured serial cost 5.3 %). Every probe prints probe_wall=..s so the first leg verifies the estimate. Motivation: H1-STOCKY sat at 11/12 for three consecutive legs failing a DIFFERENT single cell each time -- a stochastic tail an end-of-leg judgment cannot catch but an in-run probe every 8 updates can.
